name: Gmail
verdict: The scope you pick decides the project. Sending mail needs a short verification. Reading mail means restricted-scope review plus a paid security assessment renewed every year. Until verified, your app is capped at 100 users for its lifetime and test tokens die after 7 days.

creation.label: Moderate
creation.note: About 10 minutes to a Testing-mode app in our test.

approval.label: Very hard (read)
approval.note: Read access needs verification plus a CASA security assessment. Send-only is moderate.

handsOn.note: Domain verification, privacy policy, demo video, scope justifications. Plus assessor work for read access.

waiting.note: Brand check 2 to 3 business days; sensitive scopes under a week; restricted scopes plus CASA several weeks.

ownApp.headline: Start on Composio's managed Gmail app.
ownApp.note: It skips verification for you, but users see Composio on Google's consent screen, scopes are fixed (full mailbox in Composio's own test) and quota is shared. Move to your own app when branding or narrow scopes matter.

oneWayDoors.title: The 100-user cap counts for the app's lifetime.
oneWayDoors.detail: Google's console says the cap before verification is 100 users, counted over the entire lifetime of the app. You cannot reset it.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Use a separate Google Cloud project for development and testing so you do not burn your production project's 100 users.

oneWayDoors.title: "Internal" is only for Google Workspace organizations.
oneWayDoors.detail: Without Workspace, the Internal option is disabled; the console says you can only make the app available to external users.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Solo developers and startups without Workspace should plan for verification from day one.

oneWayDoors.title: Uploading a logo triggers verification.
oneWayDoors.detail: The Branding page says that after you upload a logo you must submit for verification, unless the app is internal or in Testing.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Skip the logo until you are ready to submit.

oneWayDoors.title: Adding a restricted scope later means a new assessment.
oneWayDoors.detail: A new restricted scope may require reassessment if your last CASA did not cover it.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Pick your restricted scopes once, before the assessment.

notes.title: Composio's managed app is a valid launch path
notes.text: Many teams launch on Composio's verified Gmail app and move to their own once the product is proven. You trade branding, scope control and dedicated quota for skipping the review.

scopes.intro: Google classifies every scope as non-sensitive, sensitive or restricted. The console sorted our scopes into these groups for us.

steps.title: Sign in and create a project
steps.detail: console.cloud.google.com. The console may stay on another project until you switch.

steps.title: Run the Google Auth Platform setup
steps.detail: App name, support email, audience (External), contact email.

steps.title: Agree to the User Data Policy and create
steps.detail: Configuration is created in Testing status.

steps.title: Add scopes under Data Access
steps.detail: Gmail scopes only appear once the Gmail API is enabled; otherwise paste them in "Manually add scopes".

steps.title: Create an OAuth client
steps.detail: Web application, with the Composio callback as the redirect URI.

steps.detail: In Google Search Console, with DNS or site access. An agent cannot do this for you.

steps.detail: Homepage, privacy policy, terms, authorized domains, demo video.

steps.title: Brand and data access verification
steps.detail: Brand check 2 to 3 business days. Sensitive scopes typically under a week.

steps.title: CASA assessment (restricted scopes only)
steps.detail: Scan, fix findings, answer the questionnaire, respond daily.

stepsNote: In our test: about 10 minutes to a Testing-mode app with Gmail scopes and three approvals. Production needs the human-only steps above.

approval.whenNeeded: Before any user outside your test list, and before your 100th user ever.
approval.cost: Verification is free. CASA through an assessor: reported about $540 to $3,000+ per year.
approval.renewal: Restricted scopes: CASA at least every 12 months. Google emails about 90 days before expiry.

stages.label: Brand
stages.detail: Publish within 7 days of a compliant result.

stages.label: Restricted
stages.detail: Google says several weeks; prepared teams report 5 to 20 days.

stages.label: CASA
stages.detail: With an authorized assessor, then a Letter of Assessment.

rejections: Privacy policy missing Limited Use language
approval.note: Replying to Google and your assessor quickly is the biggest lever on time.

notes.title: The 7-day trap
notes.text: In Testing, refresh tokens expire after 7 days. An agent that works in your demo will silently disconnect a week later.

rows.breaks: User revokes, password change, or 6 months unused

rules.title: Limited Use.

rules.title: No general model training

impact.title: Design impact
impact.text: If your agent reads mail, budget for CASA, a yearly renewal and an AI-use disclosure.

credentialHandoff.summary: The OAuth client is created in the console. An agent can create it and copy the secret into Composio; domain verification and policy acceptance still need you.
